title: Your start with Situate
briefHelp: Tell Situate what you have today and what you want to keep or change. We’ll work out the details together.
sourceLabel: Where are your notes and tasks today?
sourcePlaceholder: For example, project notes in Apple Notes and to-dos in Reminders.
intentLabel: How would you like to work?
keep: Keep my current way of working
change: Make a change — I have some ideas
help: Help me find a simple starting point
preferences: What should stay, or work better?
preferencesHint: Optional. Describe routines, frustrations or something you want to try.
methodQuestion: Would you like to use this working method?
changeQuestion: What would you like to change?
togetherAnswer: One place for notes and tasks
separateAnswer: Separate places for notes and tasks
importQuestion: How would you like to continue?
supportQuestion: Would you like a project overview, or finish setup without one?
finishQuestion: Ready to finish setup and enter your workspace?
buildSelected: I’ll start the project overview in a separate conversation after you finish setup. Your notes stay usable while it is being built.
supportReply: The overview would bring the imported project notes and open tasks together without moving their folders. You can also finish without it and decide later.
importReply: The copies already brought over remain available. We can try the remaining content again or leave it for later.
request: Help me set up this workspace.
freshRequest: I’m starting without importing existing content.
sourceRequest: My notes and tasks are here:
inspect: I’ll first look at the sources without changing them, then propose how we’ll work. I won’t import anything until you confirm the working method.
existingMethodQuestion: How do you currently organize new notes and tasks? One everyday example will help me keep the method you already use.
cancelled: Stopped. Files already brought over remain available. Your conversation and draft are still here.
error: Some work could not be completed. The files already brought over are still available.
sourceBlocked: I couldn’t open the selected source. We can try again, use an export, or continue without importing it. Your working method is already saved.
partial: The first note is here, but the remaining source could not be read. We can try the remaining items again or leave them for later.
preparationFailed: I couldn’t prepare a working method. Your starting details are still here. Try again, or tell me more in this conversation.
noted: I’ve noted your message. We can use it as we continue this setup.
freshQuestion: Would you prefer one place to capture everything, or separate places for notes and tasks?
developmentResponse: I’ve noted that requirement for the project overview. The source notes remain unchanged.
question: Which part of your existing organization matters most to keep: the folders, your task lists, or a particular routine?
noSourcesProposal: Keep a simple place for new notes and an open/completed task list. Add folders or routines only when they become useful. Don’t assume deadlines or a review schedule.
keepFreshProposal: Use the existing working method and routines you describe for new notes and tasks. Keep those rules unless you ask to change them. Don’t introduce a new productivity system or recurring routine.
changeFreshProposal: Use your stated preferences as the starting point for new notes and tasks. Keep the structure simple and check changes with you before adding recurring routines.
keepProposal: Keep the existing project folders and note groupings. Preserve completed tasks, dates and extra source details. Keep note checklists as checklists. Ask before changing the filing rules or adding a recurring routine.
changeProposal: Keep the original information while arranging the copies around your stated preferences. Keep notes and tasks connected to the same projects. Don’t impose a new system or add recurring routines without agreement.
proposalMessage: Here’s a starting point we can adjust. Nothing here becomes your working instructions until you confirm it.
sourceObservation: I’ll use the existing notes and task lists as our starting point, and ask about routines rather than assuming them.
agreed: That’s our working method. I’ll now bring over the selected notes and tasks, leaving the originals unchanged. You can stay here or open the app; I’ll continue in this conversation.
emptyReady: Your workspace is ready for new notes and tasks. You don’t need an extra plugin to begin. We can add structure when you have a concrete need.
importReady: Your three files are here. The originals are unchanged. A project overview could be useful if you want to see the imported project notes together.
importDeferred: We’ll leave the remaining import for later. The files already brought over stay available, and you can return to this conversation when you want to continue.
finished: Your setup choices are saved. You can keep using this conversation whenever you want to adjust the way we work.
developmentMessage: I’ll prepare a project overview using the agreed working method and existing notes. The source notes remain usable while I work.
parallelHelp: Your setup conversation is still available in the sidebar.
newChatResponse: Let’s work on that here. Your setup conversation remains separate, so its import can continue.
noFiles: No files have been imported yet.

controls.heading: Conversational setup
controls.question: Ask a follow-up question
controls.note: Proposal. Responses, source observations, imports and development are scripted. The same existing finale opens the app after early entry or completed setup; returning between views does not replay it.
